checks.summary: pointer and manifest identity
fragment bytes, rows, schema and partitions
table keys unique and required columns non-null
enumerations, finite floats and JSON columns
the promotion gate (validate_dataset) re-run on the pinned snapshot
player-game membership, season, stage, date and result
alias and duplicate identities resolve to one canonical player
season rows recomputed from accepted match rows
behinds and Brownlow arithmetic
unusual but valid values
era coverage: zero-fill and blank-as-null
fixture freshness claims backed by PASS observations and pins
timestamps and staleness against the explicit --as-of
pinned season fixture vs accepted matches
captured match pages vs canonical match and player rows
closure, seal, embedded data and binding to the snapshot and validation record
validate_release (allowlist, private content, schemas, references)
every match, log and player resource recomputed from the facts
bundle manifests, payload hashes, feature spec/order and knowledge cutoff
prediction files, labels, values, intervals, eligibility and availability
inputs unchanged on disk for the whole audit
